children: Correction: Announcement category updated from "Notice to general meeting" to "Inside information".

On 11 November 2026, the Management Board of AB “Ignitis grupė” (hereinafter – the Group or AB “Ignitis grupė”), legal entity code 301844044, registered office address Laisvės Ave. 10, Vilnius, decided to convene the Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (hereinafter – EGM) of the Group.
The EGM will be held on
10 December 2026, at 16:00 (Vilnius time) at Business Garden Vilnius, Laisvės Ave. 10, Vilnius, LT-04215.
Registration starts at 15:20 and closes at 15:45 (Vilnius time).
The agenda for the EGM, which is further detailed in the attached notice, is as follows:
agreement to AB “Ignitis grupė” consolidated interim management report for the nine-month period ended 30 September 2026;
approval of the set of interim condensed financial statements of AB “Ignitis grupė” for the nine-month period ended 30 September 2026;
allocation of dividends to the shareholders of AB “Ignitis grupė” for the period ended 30 September 2026, which is shorter than the financial year;
approval of the new version of the Articles of Association of AB “Ignitis grupė” and the power of attorney.
Submission of comments and proposals of the Group’s Supervisory Board to the General Meeting of Shareholders of the Group

Having heard the information provided by the CEO and the Management Board of the Group and the opinion of the Audit and Risk Committee of the Group, the Supervisory Board of the Group has no observations to make on the following documents and proposes to the EGM:
to agree to the consolidated interim management report of AB “Ignitis grupė” for the nine-month period ended 30 September 2026;
to approve the set of interim condensed financial statements of AB “Ignitis grupė” for the nine-month period ended 30 September 2026;

to allocate a dividend of EUR 0.400 per ordinary registered share of AB “Ignitis grupė” to the shareholders of AB “Ignitis grupė” and pay dividends of EUR 28,955,584.00 in total to the shareholders for the nine-month period ended 30 September 2026.
